content.comment_body: The new firmware [version_no] for [product_name] allows using S7-based communication (get-put). The [product_name] [article_no] supports S7 communication, but I am unable to locate documentation detailing how to define the exchange area.

Hello, In [product_name] Soft Comfort, you need to select blocks and parameters for communication within the VM Mapping feature, found under Tool > Parameter VM Mapping. Additionally, configure the Ethernet Connection under Tool > Ethernet Connections, add a new connection, and choose Client Connections. (The [product_name] uses TSAP 03.00.) Within the connection properties, specify data transfer settings like the number of bytes to read or write. Please refer to the attachment. Hope this helps. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, I set up a connection between [product_name] and [version_no] last week. The TSAP I used was 10.01, but it can also be 11.01, 12.01, etc. This should be configured in the hardware or network settings of the [version_no]. The attached screenshot shows the address details for the connection (using [document]). Regards, [user_name]
A new question was created regarding implementing a network using [version_no] and multiple [product_name] [article_no] devices. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Community members are discussing how to set up S7-based communication between various [version_no] controllers and [product_name] devices using [product_name] Soft Comfort. The main issues center around unclear documentation for configuring exchange areas, VM Mapping, and network parameters—resulting in peer-to-peer troubleshooting and advice sharing, especially around TSAP settings.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking clear, accessible documentation and in-application support for configuring communication settings between [product_name] and [version_no] devices, with a particular focus on simplifying parameter definitions for data exchange.
